firstPlayerRule: Determine a starting player; the rulebook doesn’t say how, so choose any way your group agrees on. The other players follow in clockwise order.
clarifications: Starting money and hand size depend on seat: the 1st player gets 6 dollars and 4 cards, the 2nd 7 and 5, the 3rd 8 and 6, the 4th 9 and 7. Each player also gets 1 exchange token.
Beginning with the starting player (the one with only 6 dollars), players take turns in clockwise order.

internalEvidence: No English rulebook download was found on the current publisher sites (planbgames.com redirects to Next Move Games; eggertspiele.com redirects elsewhere), so the publisher-authored PDF hosted by 1jour-1jeu was used. Page 5 setup step 17: determine a starting player, others follow clockwise, with seat-based starting capital. Page 6: the starting player (6 dollars) begins, then clockwise. uncertainty: The rulebook gives no method for choosing the starting player.
The file is hosted by a third-party rules archive rather than the publisher; its credits page still carries a localization placeholder ("Your logo and address in this section").
